name: Claudeception
headline: Claudeception: Advanced AI Skill for Continuous
short_description: Claudeception is an advanced AI skill designed for autonomous skill extraction and continuous learning, enabling Claude Code to enhance its capabilities as it operates. This innovative tool helps users to use AI for smarter and more efficient workflows.
author: blader

sections.overview:
Claudeception solves a fundamental problem with AI coding agents: they start from zero each session, forcing you to re-solve problems you've already debugged. This skill enables Claude Code to autonomously extract and preserve learned knowledge into reusable skills that persist across sessions. It implements continuous learning patterns inspired by research including Voyager, CASCADE, SEAgent, and Reflexion. When Claude Code discovers solutions, fixes bugs, or learns new patterns, Claudeception captures that knowledge and makes it available for future tasks. This creates a learning system where your AI agent becomes more capable over time, eliminating redundant work and building on accumulated expertise.
Automate the extraction of debugging techniques from previous sessions to avoid repetitive troubleshooting.
Enhance AI capabilities by continuously learning from project-specific patterns and configurations.
Improve workflow efficiency by utilizing AI-driven insights for real-time data analysis.
Facilitate decision-making processes by providing advanced AI solutions based on learned knowledge.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install blader/Claudeception`
`git clone https://github.com/blader/Claudeception`
sections.usage:
```
Extract the key skills and capabilities from this description of [TOOL_NAME]. Then, create a new prompt template that demonstrates how Claude can use these skills to [ACHIEVE_GOAL]. Ensure the new prompt is actionable and includes placeholders for user inputs. Example: 'Extract the key skills from this description of Rive. Then, create a prompt template for Claude to use these skills to design an interactive animation for a mobile app.'
```
Copy

```
Based on the description of Rive, the key skills and capabilities include real-time collaboration on animations, cross-platform compatibility for various devices, and powerful animation tools with a user-friendly interface. Here is a new prompt template for Claude to use these skills to design an interactive animation for a mobile app: 'Design an interactive animation for a mobile app using Rive. The animation should be compatible with both iOS and Android devices. Include real-time collaboration features for the design team. Use the powerful animation tools to create a smooth and engaging user experience. The animation should be user-friendly and intuitive.'
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Advanced skill - requires experience with AI agents
